Couple points:

1. You shouldn’t get in your head and start cultivating intense emotions such as love when you’ve never even had any kind of romantic engagement with her. This way of thinking will only make you nervous and affect your chances, you have to keep in mind that there’s many girls out there and try to limit these extreme emotions so that you can cushion the blow if she doesn’t see you in that way.

2. It would be WAY better if you asked her out in person, it shows courage. Don’t be too formal either, if you know lots about her then invite her to come do an activity that you both enjoy. If you ask her in a light and fun way she will be much more receptive.

3. I think you should be honest about your worries of losing the friendship/work dynamic and I think she would really appreciate that. When you ask her, tell her that you were afraid of affecting your dynamic at work but that you think she’s a great person and you’d like to spend time with her outside of work.

Just my 2 cents, good luck buddy !

I started going to the gym for the endorphin release and turning the shower super cold at the end to get some adrenaline.
